mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users_stamps (user_id, hokkaido_area_id, unlocked_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{areaId}, CURRENT_DATE)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM users_stamps WHERE user_id =#{userId} and hokkaido_area_id = #{areaId};

SELECT ha.id AS areaId, ha.name AS name, ha.image_path AS imagePath, us.user_id IS NOT NULL AS isAcquired, us.unlocked_at AS unlockedAt FROM hokkaido_areas ha LEFT JOIN users_stamps us ON ha.id = us.hokkaido_area_id AND us.user_id = #{userId}
